cards.name: Audience with Trostani
cards.oracle_text: Create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then draw cards equal to the number of differently named creature tokens you control.

research.note: Adds a Plant and rewards a mixture of differently named creature tokens, so Treefolk tokens, Saprolings, and other partner tokens can improve the draw.
research.caution: Counts distinct names rather than total tokens; a large board of identical Saprolings still contributes only one name.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Fungal Bloom
cards.oracle_text: {G}{G}: Put a spore counter on target Fungus.

research.note: Accelerates a spore-counter Fungus plan without adding another creature and can prepare counters for existing conversion abilities.
research.caution: Targets Fungi only and grants no token-making ability itself; Fungi without a way to spend spore counters need another supporting card.
research.manaNote: Double green to cast and another double green for each added spore counter.

cards.name: Fungal Sprouting
cards.oracle_text: Create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.

research.note: Converts the greatest power among the player's creatures into Saprolings, directly rewarding a large Plant or Treefolk partner.
research.caution: Counts power at resolution; removal or shrink effects can reduce the output, and it does little on an empty board.
research.manaNote: Four mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Golgari Germination
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: Leaves a Saproling whenever any allied nontoken creature dies, supporting resilient mixed-theme boards and sacrifice play.
research.caution: Token deaths do not trigger it; exile and bounce also bypass the effect.
research.manaNote: Three mana requiring black and green.

cards.name: Nissa, Voice of Zendikar
cards.oracle_text:
+1: Create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.
−2: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
−7: You gain X life and draw X cards, where X is the number of lands you control.

research.note: Creates Plants and can place counters on every allied creature, including Treefolk, Fungi, and Saprolings.
research.caution: Introduces planeswalker combat and loyalty rules; repeated token and counter production may be strong for a modest packet environment.
research.manaNote: Three mana including double green; starting loyalty is three.

cards.name: Wrenn and Seven
cards.oracle_text:
+1: Reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
0: Put any number of land cards from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
−3: Create a green Treefolk creature token with reach and "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control."
−8: Return all permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. You get an emblem with "You have no maximum hand size."

research.note: Creates a Treefolk scaled by lands, develops a landfall plan, and can fill the graveyard for later recovery.
research.caution: Five-mana planeswalker with several modes adds complexity; its zero ability needs lands in hand rather than searching for them.
research.manaNote: Five mana including double green; starting loyalty is five.

cards.name: Verdant Embrace
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has "At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token."

research.note: Improves any creature and makes Saprolings on every upkeep, linking a large attacker to a continuing token supply.
research.caution: An Aura risks losing both cards to removal; it triggers on opponents' upkeeps too and can produce tokens rapidly.
research.manaNote: Five mana including double green.

cards.name: Scatter the Seeds
cards.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Create three 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

research.note: Creates three Saprolings at instant speed, with small Plants or other tokens helping pay through convoke.
research.caution: Tapping creatures to convoke can give up attacks or blocks; without bodies the full five-mana cost matters.
research.manaNote: Costs 3GG, but green creatures can pay green or generic portions and other creatures can pay generic portions.

cards.name: Spore Swarm
cards.oracle_text: Create three 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

research.note: An uncomplicated instant makes three Saprolings for blocking, sacrifice, or the next attack.
research.caution: Provides no card selection or additional effect, so compare its rate and timing with other token makers rather than automatically including all of them.
research.manaNote: Four mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Sprout Swarm
cards.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Buyback {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: Turns a board of creatures into repeatable Saproling production through convoke and buyback.
research.caution: Repeated buyback can snowball and create slow repetitive turns; keep its potential efficiency in mind for casual playtesting.
research.manaNote: Base cost 1G with generic buyback 3; convoke can help pay both the base and additional cost.

cards.name: Saproling Symbiosis
cards.oracle_text:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash if you pay {2} more to cast it. (You may cast it any time you could cast an instant.)
Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token for each creature you control.

research.note: Creates a Saproling for every allied creature regardless of type, rewarding both developed Plant boards and Fungus tokens.
research.caution: Requires an existing board and can multiply an already dominant position; instant-speed casting costs two extra mana.
research.manaNote: Four mana with one green normally, or six total to use its flash permission.

cards.name: Trudge Garden
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you gain life, you may pay {2}. If you do, create a 4/4 green Fungus Beast creature token with trample.

research.note: Turns life-gain events from cards such as Jaddi Offshoot or Treefolk entry effects into substantial Fungus Beasts.
research.caution: Needs both a life-gain event and two mana each time; it does nothing by itself and a single large life gain is still one trigger.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green; each token payment is two generic mana.

cards.name: The Skullspore Nexus
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {X} less to cast, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
Whenever one or more nontoken creatures you control die, create a green Fungus Dinosaur creature token with base power and toughness each equal to the total power of those creatures.
{2}, {T}: Double target creature's power until end of turn.

research.note: Uses the power of dying nontoken creatures to create Fungus Dinosaur replacements, while its activated ability helps a large attacker.
research.caution: Potentially powerful resilience; token deaths do not trigger it and several creatures dying together produce one token with their combined power.
research.manaNote: Printed cost 6GG is reduced by the greatest allied power, but the two green pips remain.

cards.name: Weatherseed Totem
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
{2}{G}{G}{G}: This artifact becomes a 5/3 green Treefolk artifact creature with trample until end of turn.
When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, if it was a creature, return this card to its owner's hand.

research.note: A mana artifact later becomes a trampling Treefolk, supplying early utility and a threat in the same slot.
research.caution: It returns to hand on death only while it is a creature; repeated animation is expensive and does not remove summoning sickness.
research.manaNote: Costs three generic mana and taps for green; animation needs 2GGG.

cards.name: Druidic Satchel
cards.oracle_text: {2}, {T}: Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token. If it's a land card, put that card onto the battlefield under your control. If it's a noncreature, nonland card, you gain 2 life.

research.note: Offers Saprolings from creature cards, extra lands from land cards, or life from other cards, with every mode potentially helping a partner.
research.caution: The top card determines the mode; it is not a guaranteed token maker or ramp source, and the revealed card is not drawn.
research.manaNote: Three generic mana to cast, then two generic mana and tapping to activate.

cards.name: Vengeful Regrowth
cards.oracle_text:
Return up to three target land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Create that many 4/2 green Plant Warrior creature tokens with reach.
Flashback {6}{G}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

research.note: Returns lands and makes accompanying Plant Warriors, connecting self-mill or cycling lands with landfall and an attacking board.
research.caution: Needs land cards in the graveyard; it creates tokens only for lands actually returned and has a high mana cost.
research.manaNote: Costs 4GG, with flashback 6GG; recovered lands enter tapped.

cards.name: The Weatherseed Treaty
cards.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
II — Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
III — Domain — Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains trample until end of turn, where X is the number of basic land types among lands you control.

research.note: A single Saga can find a basic land, make a Saproling, and enhance an attacker with trample, serving several packet roles.
research.caution: Read ahead and chapter timing add decisions; the final bonus uses basic land types and may be small in a narrow mana base.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green; its first chapter can find a basic of another color.

cards.name: Tend the Sprigs
cards.oracle_text: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control seven or more lands and/or Treefolk, create a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach. (It can block creatures with flying.)

research.note: Develops a basic land early and can add a reaching Treefolk later, helping landfall and large-creature plans.
research.caution: The token requires a combined count of at least seven lands and Treefolk after the land search; it is not guaranteed early.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green; finds a basic land of any type and puts it onto the battlefield tapped.

cards.name: Sapling Nursery
cards.oracle_text:
Affinity for Forests (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each Forest you control.)
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 3/4 green Treefolk creature token with reach.
{1}{G}, Exile this enchantment: Treefolk and Forests you control gain indestructible until end of turn.

research.note: Makes Treefolk on land drops and can be exiled to protect Treefolk and Forests, linking land development to a growing board.
research.caution: Strong recurring 3/4 tokens may dominate; protection does not cover ordinary Plants or Fungi, and the discount specifically counts Forests.
research.manaNote: Printed cost 6GG is reduced by Forests; protection activation costs 1G.

cards.name: Assemble the Entmoot
cards.oracle_text:
Creatures you control have reach.
Sacrifice this enchantment: Create three tapped X/X green Treefolk creature tokens, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn. Put a reach counter on each of them.

research.note: Gives every allied creature reach and can turn life gained during a turn into three large Treefolk tokens.
research.caution: Sacrificing without life gained that turn makes zero-toughness tokens; life-gain support and sacrifice timing are essential.
research.manaNote: Four mana with one green; its sacrifice ability has no mana cost.

cards.name: Blossoming Defense
cards.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 and gains hexproof until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

research.note: Botanical protection and a power boost work on any allied creature, making it useful with every packet theme.
research.caution: Hexproof does not stop untargeted destruction or combat damage; the effect lasts only for the turn.
research.manaNote: Single green mana.

cards.name: Growing Ranks
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, populate. (Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.)

research.note: Can copy a Plant, Treefolk, Saproling, or Fungus token, providing a shared reward for diverse token makers.
research.caution: Requires a creature token already in play and waits for the controller's upkeep; the value varies greatly with the copied token.
research.manaNote: Two generic mana plus two green/white hybrid symbols, payable using green, white, or both.

cards.name: Rootborn Defenses
cards.oracle_text: Populate. Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. (To populate, create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.)

research.note: Protects the entire creature board and can copy any existing creature token, including a large Treefolk or small Saproling.
research.caution: Indestructible does not stop exile, sacrifice, or zero toughness; populate needs an existing creature token.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one white pip.

cards.name: Sundering Growth
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact or enchantment, then populate. (Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.)

research.note: Combines removal with copying a creature token of any theme, allowing a white or green packet to support a token partner.
research.caution: Needs a legal artifact or enchantment target; if the only target becomes illegal, the spell does not resolve and no populate occurs.
research.manaNote: Two green/white hybrid symbols can be paid entirely with either color.

cards.name: Vines of Vastwood
cards.oracle_text:
Kicker {G} (You may pay an additional {G} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control this turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets +4/+4 until end of turn.

research.note: Vines protect a chosen creature from opposing targeting, with an optional substantial combat boost for any faction creature.
research.caution: Its targeting restriction is not the hexproof keyword and can target opposing creatures; explain that distinction when relevant.
research.manaNote: One green normally; a second green pays the kicker for the boost.

cards.name: Wrap in Vigor
cards.oracle_text: Regenerate each creature you control.

research.note: A botanical regeneration effect can preserve a mixed board through combat or ordinary destruction.
research.caution: Regeneration differs from indestructible: it replaces a destruction event, taps the creature, and does not stop exile or sacrifice.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Khalni Garden
cards.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped.
When this land enters, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token.
{T}: Add {G}.

research.note: A land also supplies a Plant body for defense, convoke, sacrifice, or later counter growth.
research.caution: Enters tapped and its token has zero power; repeated tapped lands can delay the early game.
research.manaNote: Produces green mana; the Plant token is created on entry without an extra payment.

cards.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}{G}{W}, {T}: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: Adds a repeatable Saproling source to the mana base for games that reach spare-mana turns.
research.caution: Normally produces only colorless mana; token creation consumes its tap plus four other mana, slowing color access if overused.
research.manaNote: Produces colorless, while token production requires 2GW and tapping this land.

cards.name: Blossombind
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature can't become untapped and can't have counters put on it.

research.note: A botanical blue Aura removes an opposing creature from ordinary combat and prevents it receiving more counters.
research.caution: Does not remove abilities, so an enchanted creature may still use abilities that do not need tapping; the effect depends on the Aura staying attached.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one blue pip.

cards.name: Pinecone Strike
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one or both —
• Pinecone Strike deals 3 damage to target creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.
• Destroy target artifact token.

research.note: A botanical projectile provides red creature removal and can also destroy an artifact token, offering interaction without a creature-type restriction.
research.caution: Its exile replacement specifically weakens recurring Zombie creatures; three damage does not answer every large threat.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one red pip.
